mapper.select: WITH FUNCTION major_version RETURN NUMBER IS BEGIN RETURN DBMS_DB_VERSION.VERSION; END; SELECT SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','DB_NAME') AS "dbName", 'Oracle' AS "dbmsName", major_version() AS "majorVersion" FROM dual fetch first 1 rows only

WITH
ora_all_columns AS ( SELECT c.OWNER AS schema_name, c.TABLE_NAME AS table_name, c.COLUMN_ID AS column_num, COALESCE(com.COMMENTS, '') AS logical_column_name, c.COLUMN_NAME AS physical_column_name, c.DATA_TYPE || CASE WHEN c.DATA_TYPE IN ('VARCHAR2', 'CHAR', 'NVARCHAR2', 'NCHAR') THEN '(' || c.DATA_LENGTH || ')'
WHEN c.DATA_TYPE IN ('NUMBER') AND c.DATA_PRECISION IS NOT NULL THEN '(' || c.DATA_PRECISION || ',' || c.DATA_SCALE || ')' WHEN c.DATA_TYPE IN ('NUMBER') AND c.DATA_SCALE IS NOT NULL THEN '(*,' || c.DATA_SCALE || ')' WHEN c.DATA_TYPE IN ('FLOAT') THEN '(' || c.DATA_PRECISION || ')' ELSE '' END AS column_type, CASE WHEN c.DATA_TYPE IN ('VARCHAR2', 'CHAR', 'NVARCHAR2', 'NCHAR') THEN TO_CHAR(c.DATA_LENGTH) WHEN c.DATA_TYPE IN ('NUMBER', 'FLOAT') AND c.DATA_PRECISION IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(c.DATA_PRECISION) || CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.DATA_SCALE, 0) != 0 THEN ',' || TO_CHAR(c.DATA_SCALE) ELSE '' END ELSE '' END AS precision_scale, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ALL_CONS_COLUMNS acc JOIN ALL_CONSTRAINTS ac ON acc.OWNER = ac.OWNER AND acc.CONSTRAINT_NAME = ac.CONSTRAINT_NAME WHERE acc.OWNER = c.OWNER AND acc.TABLE_NAME = c.TABLE_NAME AND acc.COLUMN_NAME = c.COLUMN_NAME AND ac.CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'P' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS primary_key, CASE c.NULLABLE WHEN 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS not_null, CASE
WHEN c.IDENTITY_COLUMN = 'YES' THEN ( SELECT TO_CLOB('GENERATED ' || ic.GENERATION_TYPE || ' AS IDENTITY') FROM ALL_TAB_IDENTITY_COLS ic WHERE ic.OWNER = c.OWNER AND ic.TABLE_NAME = c.TABLE_NAME AND ic.COLUMN_NAME = c.COLUMN_NAME )
WHEN c.DEFAULT_LENGTH > 0 THEN REGEXP_REPLACE( long_value('SELECT data_default FROM all_tab_columns WHERE owner = :p1 AND table_name = :p2 AND column_name = :p3', c.OWNER, c.TABLE_NAME, c.COLUMN_NAME), '^\s+|\s+$', '') ELSE TO_CLOB('') END AS default_value, '' AS remarks FROM ALL_TAB_COLUMNS c LEFT OUTER JOIN ALL_COL_COMMENTS com ON c.OWNER = com.OWNER AND c.TABLE_NAME = com.TABLE_NAME AND c.COLUMN_NAME = com.COLUMN_NAME WHERE c.OWNER NOT IN
AND c.OWNER IN
#{schema}
AND c.TABLE_NAME IN
#{table}
ORDER BY c.OWNER, c.TABLE_NAME, c.COLUMN_ID ) SELECT schema_name AS "schemaName", table_name AS "tableName", logical_column_name AS "logicalColumnName", physical_column_name AS "physicalColumnName", column_type AS "columnType", precision_scale AS "precisionScale", primary_key AS "primaryKey", not_null AS "notNull", default_value AS "defaultValue" FROM ora_all_columns ORDER BY schema_name, table_name, column_num

WITH
ora_all_indexes AS ( SELECT idx.owner AS schema_name, idx.table_name AS table_name, idx.index_name AS index_name, idx.index_type AS index_method, CASE WHEN idx.uniqueness = 'UNIQUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_unique, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM all_constraints ac WHERE ac.owner = idx.owner AND ac.constraint_type = 'P' AND ac.index_name = idx.index_name ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_primary, (CASE WHEN idx.uniqueness = 'UNIQUE' THEN 'CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ' ELSE 'CREATE INDEX ' END) || idx.index_name || ' ON ' || idx.table_name || ' (' || LISTAGG( CASE WHEN ie.index_name IS NULL THEN col.column_name ELSE TO_CHAR(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(long_value( 'SELECT column_expression FROM all_ind_expressions WHERE index_owner = :p1 AND index_name = :p2 AND column_position = :p3', ie.index_owner, ie.index_name, TO_CHAR(ie.column_position)), 1000, 1)) END, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY col.column_position) || ')' AS index_definition, '' AS remarks FROM all_indexes idx LEFT JOIN all_ind_columns col ON idx.index_name = col.index_name AND idx.owner = col.index_owner LEFT JOIN all_ind_expressions ie ON idx.index_name = ie.index_name AND idx.owner = ie.index_owner AND col.column_position = ie.column_position WHERE idx.index_type != 'LOB' AND idx.OWNER NOT IN
AND idx.owner IN
#{schema}
AND idx.table_name IN
#{table}
GROUP BY idx.owner, idx.table_name, idx.index_name, idx.index_type, idx.uniqueness ) SELECT schema_name AS "schemaName", table_name AS "tableName", index_name AS "indexName", index_method AS "indexMethod", is_unique AS "isUnique", is_primary AS "isPrimary", index_definition AS "indexDefinition", remarks AS "remarks" FROM ora_all_indexes ORDER BY schema_name, table_name, index_name

SELECT DISTINCT d.OWNER AS "schemaName", d.NAME AS "viewName", CASE d.TYPE WHEN 'MATERIALIZED VIEW' THEN 'materialized_view' ELSE 'view' END AS "viewType", d.REFERENCED_OWNER AS "referenceSchemaName", d.REFERENCED_NAME AS "referenceTableName", CASE WHEN d.REFERENCED_TYPE = 'VIEW' THEN 'view' WHEN d.REFERENCED_TYPE = 'MATERIALIZED VIEW' OR m.MVIEW_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'materialized_view' ELSE 'table' END AS "referenceTableType" FROM ALL_DEPENDENCIES d LEFT OUTER JOIN ALL_MVIEWS m ON m.OWNER = d.REFERENCED_OWNER AND m.MVIEW_NAME = d.REFERENCED_NAME WHERE d.TYPE IN ('VIEW', 'MATERIALIZED VIEW') AND d.REFERENCED_TYPE IN ('TABLE', 'VIEW', 'MATERIALIZED VIEW') AND NOT (d.REFERENCED_OWNER = d.OWNER AND d.REFERENCED_NAME = d.NAME) AND d.OWNER NOT IN AND d.REFERENCED_OWNER NOT IN
AND d.OWNER IN
#{schema}
ORDER BY "schemaName", "viewName", "referenceSchemaName", "referenceTableName"

SELECT SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','DB_NAME') AS "dbName", s.sequence_owner AS "schemaName", s.sequence_name AS "sequenceName", TO_CHAR(s.increment_by) AS "incrementBy", TO_CHAR(s.min_value) AS "minValue", TO_CHAR(s.max_value) AS "maxValue", TO_CHAR(s.cache_size) AS "cacheSize", '' AS "startValue", CASE s.cycle_flag WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "cycle", '' AS "ownedBy" FROM all_sequences s WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM all_tab_identity_cols ic WHERE ic.owner = s.sequence_owner AND ic.sequence_name = s.sequence_name ) AND s.sequence_owner NOT IN
AND s.sequence_owner IN
#{schema}
ORDER BY s.sequence_owner, s.sequence_name
